messages:
clara: quick sync: prototype for 'adaptive golden selection' is ready. goal: reduce blind spots in onboarding without blowing up bench cost.
jon: nice — main questions: reproducibility and admission semantics. how do we keep postmortems actionable?
clara: design sketch: maintain a stable canonical shard for admission; in parallel select 2 adaptive windows seeded from recent traffic for sensitivity checks. runs are seeded so selections are snapshottable.
bench-bot: (automated) note: seeded selection must be logged to artifacts store for traceability.
tara: what about flakiness? adaptive windows could cause noise alerts if we pick rare inputs.
murat: we score candidate examples by a weighted metric: qps*0.6 + historic-regression-score*0.3 + novelty*0.1. tuneable per-model. also we cap contribution from ultra-low-qps inputs.
clara: operational flow: intake manifest opts into adaptive=true. onboarding pipeline does: (1) seed selector with RNG=manifest.seed (2) snapshot examples to model-registry (3) run canonical + adaptive sweeps; block only if canonical fails. adaptive hits create P0/P1 alerts depending on delta.
jon: can we make adaptive a gradual requirement? e.g., optional for small customers, required for production tiers.
clara: yes, map to enrollment tiers. we'll add gating flag.
bench-bot: (automated) checklist created: ONB-512 "adaptive golden: seeded selection, snapshotting, and tiered gating" assigned to eng-ml.
onboard-bot: (system) ticket #INT-912 created: "add seeded snapshot step to onboarding runner" assigned to infra & eng-ml.
clara: next steps: implement selector prototype (murat), add snapshot hook in bench-runner (jon), update onboarding playbook (tara). aiming for spike + demo next Tues.
